question_text: A 22-year-old female college student presents to the clinic with complaints of intense vaginal itching and a painful sensation when urinating. She also notes that she has felt more lethargic and has additionally been experiencing recent fevers and headaches. She says that she is sexually active and occasionally uses condoms. On physical exam, she is found to have red, vesicular ulcers on her labia that are painful to palpation and tender inguinal lymphadenopathy. What is the most likely pathogen causing her presentation?
